user.title: Sign in to Panasonic Smart CN
user.description: Enter the credentials for your mainland China Panasonic Smart Home app account.

device.title: Select devices
device.description: Select the devices already linked to your account. Devices marked status only do not yet support controls.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Panasonic Smart CN again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Panasonic session has expired. Enter the password for the linked account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Panasonic. Check your network connection.
error.invalid_auth: The Panasonic account or password is invalid.

abort.no_devices_found: There are no devices linked to this account.
abort.already_configured: This Panasonic account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Panasonic account as before.
abort.reauth_required: Reauthenticate the Panasonic account in Home Assistant first.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve the devices from the Panasonic account.

air_volume_locked.message: Disinfection mode uses a fixed high speed. Change the operating mode to adjust the speed.

control_not_confirmed.message: Panasonic received the command, but the reported state did not match it in time.

control_failed.message: Could not control the Panasonic device. Check the device status and account connection.

data.auto_relogin: Automatically reconnect after session expiry (may affect the mobile app session)
